title: Ripple-carry circuit specification
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $x$ assign a Boolean value to each of the $n$ input positions, and let $k,i$ be natural numbers with $3k\le n$ and $i\le k$. After running the circuit consisting of the initial two constant gates followed by $i$ bit blocks on the input list of $x$, the resulting list has length $n+2+15i$. Its value at the carry index is the carry bit after $i$ positions for the input streams beginning at offsets $0$ and $k$. Its value at the accumulator index is true exactly when, at every position below $i$, the sum bit from the streams beginning at offsets $0$ and $k$ agrees with the input stream beginning at offset $2k$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ assigns Boolean values to the $n$ input positions
